deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: Prevents accidental or unauthorized Terraform destruction of critical multicloud destination infrastructure. A policy should require the deletion-blocking value PREVENT.

description.rationale: Provides descriptive metadata only and does not control connectivity, routing, access, or data protection.

ip_prefix.description: The IP prefix that represents your workload on another CSP.
ip_prefix.rationale: Represents the remote workload prefix. The correct CIDR is environment-specific routing architecture and cannot be generically constrained without organization-specific network values.

labels.description:
User-defined labels.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Provides resource metadata and governance information but does not directly control connectivity, routing, access, or data protection.

location.rationale: Controls the deployment location. Restricting it to a parameterized list of approved regions supports data-residency and infrastructure-placement requirements.

multicloud_data_transfer_config.description: The multicloud data transfer config of the destination.
multicloud_data_transfer_config.rationale: References the multicloud data-transfer configuration associated with the destination. Resource references are outside generic policy scope and should not be hardcoded.

name.rationale: Identifies the destination resource but does not directly control connectivity, routing, access, or data protection.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Selects the owning project. It is a resource-placement identifier and requires organization-specific project values rather than a generic platform security rule.

endpoints.description: The list of DestinationEndpoint resources configured for the IP prefix.

endpoints.asn.description: The ASN of the remote IP prefix.
endpoints.asn.rationale: Defines the remote autonomous system used for routing. The ASN is an environment-specific network architecture value rather than a generic platform security control.

endpoints.csp.description: The CSP of the remote IP prefix.
endpoints.csp.rationale: Identifies the cloud service provider for the remote prefix. Provider selection is an architectural choice and is not inherently secure or insecure.
